title: Visitor calls Strieber 'the luckiest of the lucky'

tellings.quote: one of the visitors when I was in the abduction experience said to me, "You're the luckiest of the lucky."

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer who says he has been abducted by beings he calls "the visitors," says that during one abduction in the 1980s one of them told him, "You're the luckiest of the lucky." He tells Michels this as something he lived through. If true, it would suggest the beings saw his contact with them as a gift.
